q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER , COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN ( SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWEE FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW)) GROUP BY FOLLOWEE ORDER BY FOLLOWER
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER , COUNT(*) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN ( SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWEE FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT DISTINCT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW)) GROUP BY FOLLOWEE ORDER BY FOLLOWER
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because they count the number of followers for each followee differently. Q1 counts the number of followers for each followee where the followee is also a follower of someone else. Q2 counts the number of followers for each followee where the followee is also a followee of someone else.
counterexample_dsp: Consider a scenario where user A follows user B, and user B follows user A. In this case, Q1 will count user B as a follower of user A, but Q2 will not count user B as a follower of user A because user B is not a followee of anyone else.
